name: ingame-block-crash
description: Fabric 1.21.1 client in a world (drawn on a virtual screen), a mod throws while the blocks of a chunk are drawn

name: real-client-fabric-api-wrong-point-release
description: Fabric 1.21.1 client with the Fabric API built for 1.21
fix: Take the Fabric API built for the exact point release you play.

name: real-client-iris-needs-older-sodium
description: Fabric 1.21.1 client, Iris 1.8.8 with Sodium 0.8.12-alpha.4
fix: Iris 1.8.8 only works with Sodium 0.6.x: install that branch, or a newer Iris.

name: real-client-create-standalone-flywheel
description: Forge 1.18.2 client with Create 0.5.1.c and a Flywheel installed by hand, too old for it
fix: Delete the Flywheel jar you added: Create carries its own inside.

name: real-client-dependency-never-published
description: Forge 1.20.1 client, the Oculus/Flywheel bridge asking for a Flywheel that is not there at all
fix: Install Flywheel, or remove the bridge mod that asks for it.

name: real-client-fabric-api-corrupt
description: Fabric 1.21.1 client whose fabric-api jar was cut short by a failed download
fix: Delete that jar and download it again: it is there but unreadable, so the loader calls it missing.

name: real-client-forge-config-truncated
description: Forge 1.19.2 client whose forge-resource-caching.toml was left half written
fix: Delete config/forge-resource-caching.toml: Forge writes a new one.

name: real-client-sodium-breaks-iris-recent
description: Fabric 1.21.11 client, Sodium 0.8.14 saying it cannot live with Iris 1.10.7
fix: Update Iris past 1.10.7, or drop Sodium to a build that accepts it.

name: real-client-dependency-that-does-not-exist
description: Fabric 1.21.1 client, a mod asking for a library its own author never published
fix: That library was never released: take a build of the mod from Modrinth instead.
